component.name: Gamble Client Launcher
component.summary: Install, update, and launch Gamble Client for Minecraft

description.p: Gamble Client Launcher manages isolated Minecraft profiles, authenticated Gamble Client builds, Fabric dependencies, and Microsoft account sessions.
The Flatpak ships the same native launcher interface as the Windows, RPM and DEB packages, and includes Java 21 so it does not depend on a system Java installation.

Updates now only ever move forward: the launcher refuses older, equal or below-minimum versions, and handles pre-release version tags correctly. The game starts with Java attach protection, and update checks are stricter and clearer.
The client build picked in Profiles is now the build that launches. The Gamble Client logo and clearer icons replace the letter badges, and accounts whose skin cannot load show their initial.
Verifies launcher updates with a Gamble Client signature and checks every Minecraft, Fabric and Java download against its published hash.
Adds an upgrade banner for Ad Tier accounts and a sale banner with a countdown and coupon code to the launcher home screen.
Ships the real launcher interface in the Flatpak, adds motion and polish to the launcher, and makes Flatpak installs update with the Flatpak bundle.
Flattens the launcher to a matte black and solid silver palette with no gradients, keeping the existing layout.
Redesigns the launcher with a graphite and mint layout, left navigation and a clearer current-client overview.
Adds Launch another for owner and developer accounts, safer request retries, and clearer Play-again guidance after one-use authorization.
Adds a saved compatibility preference to disable optional Gamble shader effects on the next Minecraft start.
Corrects native GPU recovery classification so a preventive AMD safeguard notice does not select the alternate GPU.
Refines Play, adds calmer opening motion and launch progress, and respects reduced-motion preferences.
Quietens window headers, improves profiles and settings, and shows sponsor prompts only when Play needs them.
Fixes profile creation, keyboard navigation, access refresh and launch recovery guidance.
Simplifies Play and Dashboard access, protects sign-in files, and makes downloads and startup more resilient.
Adds Linux-safe launcher startup, resilient backend gateways, and a bundled Java 21 runtime.
